headline: Rising home prices fueled by jeonse and monthly rent shortages spread beyond Gangnam [Home prices, longest rally ②]
summary: Seoul apartment sale prices have risen for 86 consecutive weeks, a record run. The rally is now led by non-Gangnam areas amid jeonse and monthly rent shortages and lending restrictions.
why: Housing prices affect household wealth, bank mortgage lending, and the policy decisions of Korean regulators.
